The open-source framework and platform **AMP - Accelerated Mobile Pages** at **`amp.dev`** is provided and hosted by the **OpenJS Foundation** alongside **AMP Project contributors** (originally created and backed by Google, and later transitioned to open governance under the OpenJS Foundation).

### Evidence & Citations
From the official site footer across **`amp.dev`**:
* **Provider / Copyright Statement:**  
  > *"© OpenJS Foundation and AMP Project contributors. All rights reserved. The OpenJS Foundation has registered trademarks and uses trademarks."*
* **Related Services Notice:**  
  > *"The services available at cdn.ampproject.org are provided by Google and the respective privacy policy applies."*
